observations: Photo 0 shows multiple wrapped automotive powertrain components (engines/gearboxes) laid out on the floor, each covered with plastic/cloth.
No readable VIN/engine number, no visible model badge, and no clear identification of which exact engine/gearbox is being offered.
No photo shows the engine block casting details, intake manifold label, or gearbox code plate.

claims.claim: Toyota Corolla 2010 engine and gear box 2ZR
claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not show any readable engine/gearbox code, badge, or number to confirm 2ZR or that it matches Corolla 2010.

risks.risk: Wrong engine/gearbox variant (e.g., not 2ZR, or different displacement/trim) leading to incompatible mounts/ECU/parts.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photos of the engine block stamping/engine number and the gearbox code plate (or casting marks), plus a photo showing the intake manifold/engine cover labels.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unidentified used engine/gearbox bundle with compatibility risk (worst case: may require extra parts and may not fit).

risks.risk: Unknown condition (running status, compression, internal damage, oil leaks) because components are wrapped and not tested.
risks.proof: Video of a cold start (if available) or compression test results + leak-down test (or at minimum, a test run video showing it drives/engages).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven/untested (worst case: treat as for spares or rebuild).

risks.risk: Missing parts/accessories (starter, alternator, sensors, ECU, wiring harness, mounts, flywheel/torque converter) that affect total cost and usability.
risks.proof: A full inventory photo list laid out item-by-item, including what is included/excluded (starter, alternator, ECU, sensors, mounts, drive plate/flywheel, shifter linkage).
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete (worst case: buyer must source missing accessories).

risks.risk: Potential mismatch between engine and gearbox (wrong pairing) causing gear ratio/shift issues or ECU/immobilizer problems.
risks.proof: Photo of gearbox code + photo of mating surfaces/part numbers, and confirmation of whether it is manual or automatic (and model year pairing).
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case mismatch risk (worst case: may not bolt up or may not work without additional parts).

risks.risk: Scam/over-claim risk: multiple engines/gearboxes shown, but the offered unit is not clearly singled out.
risks.proof: Photo that clearly marks the exact engine/gearbox being sold (e.g., same unit with a tag/number) and close-ups of its identifiers.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the least certain option (worst case: cannot verify which unit you will receive).

proof_requests: Unwrap and take close-up photos of the engine number/stamping on the block and the gearbox code plate.
Provide a clear photo showing which exact engine/gearbox is for sale (tag/label on the specific unit).
Confirm whether it is manual or automatic, and provide gearbox code + pairing details.
Show included accessories and what is missing (starter/alternator/sensors/ECU/wiring harness/mounts/flywheel or torque converter).
If possible, provide a test video (start + idle) or compression/leak-down results.
response.reason: The photo shows wrapped multiple powertrain components but provides no readable identifiers or test evidence to confirm the claimed 2ZR engine/gearbox and condition. Without that, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
